sources.title: Orion
sources.text:
Orion Gateway versions through 9.1 (inclusive) allow code execution only when custom handlers and upload tracking are both enabled.
A patch has not been released. Set feature.upload_progress=off and restart all workers. Discontinue use if the mitigation is unavailable.

Orion Console permits authenticated administrators to cause denial of service when importing a malformed configuration.

Orion Console permits unauthenticated code execution. Upgrade to 12.0.
